Rodney’s argument focuses on European capitalist exploitation draining Africa’s wealth and impeding development, which aligns historically with the transatlantic slave trade and the forced movement of Africans to the Americas as part of the African diaspora.  
This fits the period 1450–1750, when European powers did not yet colonize Africa’s interior (that came later, in the 19th century), but they did engage heavily in the slave trade, which underdeveloped Africa by removing human resources and disrupting societies.  

Thus, the best match is the expansion of the African diaspora to the New World.  

Final answer: (B)
